summary.text: Corondor is a large island on Dominaria north of Jamuraa, the setting of many Armada comics and of the Planeswalker War.

bio.text: In the past it saw the Enslavement of Trine, in which Xarl bound the angel Trine and became the most powerful man in Corondor, and the later conquests of Geyadrone Dihada, who corrupted Sol'Kanar and set about conquering Corondor.
The Blackblade-Dihada war began when Dihada destroyed Carth, and it ended with Dakkon killing Piru, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, before Dihada bound Dakkon to her will.
Sivitri Scarzam raided its southeastern part with a dragon horde until poppy poison made by Sol'Kanar killed the Scarzam dragons and she left Dominaria.

Ravidel lured six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forced them to battle in the Planeswalker War, and he was defeated, losing control of the land while Jared became the next Elder Druid.
Around the New Phyrexian Invasion, Corondor fell under Dihada's control again, and Dihada returned in 4562 to take the Tolarian Academy and Corondor.

status.text: Corondor is described as falling again under Geyadrone Dihada's control around the New Phyrexian Invasion, and the latest story mentions it as a kingdom usurped by Sol'kanar.
